WIC17A-01.note: Layer is ground off and binned unanalyzed because its lipids are contaminated: the step sacrifices material. 'Diagnostic' is the tempting lab word but is killed by 'without being analyzed'; 'redundant' is odd as a deliberate first step.

WIC17A-02.note: She suspects the effect holds only with the new anesthetic protocol: contingent. Each distractor has its own killer clause: 'not a fluke' (spurious), 'large effect' (marginal), 'should not change prescribing' (definitive).

WIC17A-03.note: Parts swapped by two workers in an afternoon vs five-month closure: repairable. Durable/affordable/substantial are each pre-killed (repeated replacements, cost more, says nothing about strength); plain key word.

WIC17A-04.note: Bees visit but set no more seed than bagged flowers: pollinators in name only, nominal. 'Occasional' killed by 4-to-1 frequency, 'efficient' by no seed, 'exclusive' by bumblebees.

WIC17A-05.note: Light elements not registered; 'it simply reports nothing': silent. 'Fickle' is the tempting failure word but is killed by 'behaves the same way on every scan'; sluggish/invasive killed by the first sentence.

WIC17A-06.note: Two halves deposited 4,000 years apart with a soil between: one arc made of two moraines, composite. 'Fragmentary' tempts but the arc is unbroken; 'displaced' killed by the final sentence; 'uniform' is the old view.

WIC17B-01.note: Only cases judges chose to circulate were reported, so the count covers a selected part of the record (and is skewed): partial. 'Inexact' is the strongest lure but the count itself is exact for what it covers; 'trivial' killed by 'still worth knowing'.

WIC17B-02.note: Showing a drawing instead of naming the word avoids leading the speaker: indirect elicitation. Key fit is somewhat loose ('non-leading' is the real idea); hurried and public are killed outright by 'a full minute' and 'sat alone', and 'voluntary' has no support.

WIC17B-03.note: Unmoved prices, open smuggling, no petitions: a tax on paper only, nominal. 'Temporary' killed by 1790-1831, 'ruinous' by flat prices, 'disputed' by 'never once petitioned'. Same key word as WIC17A-04.

WIC17B-04.note: Same beats for every fiddler and 'no longer the tune' without them: integral. Optional is the transcribers' view, individual killed by uniformity, borrowed by absence from neighbors.

WIC17B-05.note: Same castle from one pricked drawing behind three saints, never in contracts, unrelated to legends: generic stock scenery. 'Symbolic' killed by the last sentence, 'specified' by the contracts, 'unfinished' by 'fully painted'.

WIC17B-06.note: Equal payments, each receives the pot once: reciprocal (rotating savings). Charitable is the refuted received view, compulsory killed by 'could leave', secretive by 'read aloud at every meeting'.
